results.title: Ecoinvent, what about it? —
results.content: # Ecoinvent, what about it? The background database ecoinvent is used during the LCA study so that standard processes do not have to be rebuilt and analyzed each time. Ecoinvent is an LCA background database, and underlies all environmental declarations in the NMD. Drawing up an environmental declaration is done through an LCA study according to the rules described in the Assessment Method. The background database ecoinvent is used during the LCA study so that standard processes do not have to be rebuilt and analyzed each time. ## Ecoinvent in the Assessment Method. When performing an LCA study on a building product for the purpose of an environmental statement in the NMD, the use of ecoinvent is required. Although ecoinvent is not the only LCA background database available, it is considered the most complete and transparent database in Europe. Since several studies have shown that the same calculations based on other background databases can give very different results, it is very important that the Assessment Method designates one specific database. Therefore, the mandatory use of ecoinvent including specific version number is included in the Assessment Method. Once a year the NMD Technical Content Committee (TIC) discusses whether an update of the prescribed version of ecoinvent is desirable. Currently, ecoinvent version 3.6 is required for submitting data to NMD. As of 1-1-2025 a change in the Assessment Method will take effect, after which ecoinvent 3.9.1 will be required for supplying 'Set A2' data. In addition, Ecoinvent 3.6 will always remain valid for the 'Set A1' data of environmental statements. ## The NMD process database. Ecoinvent is the most common background process database in Europe, but the NMD also offers a process database tailored to the Dutch situation. The latest version of the process database contains relevant ecoinvent processes, based on ecoinvent 3.6 and ecoinvent 3.9.1. The NMD process database also contains category 1 and 2 data for “semi-finished products. Five questions for Sjoerd Keetels. Five questions for Paul ten Kroode. Five questions for David Anink. results.content: New release: **SimaPro 10.3 with Agri-Footprint 7** is now available! # ecoinvent EN15804. The ecoinvent database is a life cycle inventory (LCI) database that supports various types of sustainability assessments. Different system models are available, including the Allocation, cut-off, EN15804 model which was specifically developed to meet the needs of Environmental Product Declaration (EPD) practitioners. This system model is fully compliant with ISO 14025, ISO 21930 and EN15804+A2:2019, and adheres to the end-of-waste criteria set by the European Commission. ## Why choose ecoinvent EN15804? ecoinvent EN15804 system model is fully compliant with ISO 14025, ISO 21930 and EN15804+A2:2019. Additionally, it includes a method that facilitates calculating the EN 15804+A2 impact assessment and life cycle inventory indicators in one go. #### How does ecoinvent EN15804 differ from other system models? The “Allocation, cut-off, EN15804 system model” follows the underlying principles of the cut-off approach. Similar to the cut-off system model, producers of waste bear the burden of the waste treatment, based on the “polluter pays” principle. The key differences of the Allocation, cut-off, EN15804 compared to the Allocation, cut-off by classification system model are:. #### Prerequisites for using ecoinvent EN15804. ecoinvent EN15804 is available as an add-on to the ecoinvent database and can be purchased for an additional fee. To acquire ecoinvent EN15804, you must meet the following criteria:. * You are using SimaPro Craft 10.1 (or a later version) with ecoinvent 3.11. * You have a valid ecoinvent subscription/license for this system model. PRé Sustainability, the developer of SimaPro, provides a replacement file for SimaPro users who wish to update their projects from the allocation, cut-off by classification system model to allocation, cut-off, EN15804 system model. **Contact us to purchase ecoinvent EN15804**. ecoinvent is a not-for-profit association based in Zurich, Switzerland, dedicated to the availability of high-quality data for sustainability assessments worldwide. Dedicated to promoting and supporting the use of environmental data worldwide, the ecoinvent Association focuses on LCI data compilation, linking and distribution, as well as data and database management. Its main activity is the publication of the ecoinvent database, which is used worldwide as a background database in LCA and other environmental assessments.
